section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the Broad Conceptualization of Beauty Scale (Tylka & Iannantuono, 2016) used to measure participants' agreement with statements about beauty on a 5-point scale. The scale demonstrated good internal consistency (Cronbach's α = 0.81) and adequate model fit in confirmatory factor analysis (RMSEA = 0.072, CFI = 0.954, TLI = 0.932, SRMR = 0.039).
section_summary.evidence_source: Section 2.2.4 describing the Broad Conceptualization of Beauty Scale measurement instrument and its psychometric properties.
